reuse.why: Extends the existing shared link guard in link.ts that all six providers already call, and extracts the unlink-account field reset so unlinkAccount and the takeover share it.

duplication.why: The local unlink update is moved into clearLocalBankLink and called from both places; no logic is copied.

placement.why: Link-rule logic stays in server/accounts/link.ts beside the existing guard; providers only pass the new flag through.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing, the guard extension, the extracted helper and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clean and centralised, though renaming the assert into prepareBankAccountLink mixes validation with a side effect (unlinking holders) that runs before the bank lookup and sync, which a maintainer has to keep in mind.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All providers go through link.prepareBankAccountLink and unlinkAccount uses clearLocalBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the unlink reset was extracted rather than copied.
